## Which file do I need?

| You want to… | Download |
|---|---|
| Play straight away on any computer | **cognitive-terrain-0.16.2.html**, then double-click it to open in your browser |
| Read the rules | **Cognitive-Terrain-Field-Manual-0.16.2.pdf** |
| Run it for a group, build campaigns, see why it works | **Cognitive-Terrain-Practitioners-Manual-0.16.2.pdf** |
| Hear each week read aloud (optional) | the **Immersive Briefings** voice pack, on its own release: **voice-emma-1** |
| Install it like a normal program | **…-Setup.exe** (Windows), **…-macOS-AppleSilicon.zip** or **…-macOS-Intel.zip** (Mac), **…-Linux.tar.gz** |
| Host it on itch.io | **…-web.zip** |

The installers are not code-signed yet, so Windows and macOS warn on first
launch. **PLAYTEST-README.txt** explains how to get past the warning.

Two-player games work between any of these files, as long as both players
use version 0.16.2.

## What's new

- **Accuracy.** The in-game Guide and both manuals now match the game's code:
  - when one side's crisis goes ERROR, the other side gets +1;
  - a tie goes to clearly healthier decisions (by more than 0.03), or is a
    draw;
  - Donovia's dormant narratives hit twice as hard, and its framing lasts
    three weeks;
  - the flood, Show of Force and reach numbers in the Practitioner's Manual
    are now exact.
- **Playtest page.** Longer notes now open with one line and list the
  details underneath, so they are easier to scan. The opening animation has
  its full colour back.
- No rule changes. Two-player codes work between 0.16 builds.
